messages.text: Your USB wall charger was returned, and the refund proposal is for **BRL 13.65**. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review the request.
The customer confirmed request prop-0d3d794f78194559 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
Your refund of **BRL 13.65** has been processed. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
Thanks. What date should the refund reach my card?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"When should an executed refund reach the customer's card? Refund processing or card posting timeline."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I can’t give you a specific arrival date. The shop’s policy says an automatic refund goes to the order’s original payment method when eligible, but doesn’t specify how long it takes to appear on your card (refund-policy/v1/payment).
Will it be on my card within a few days?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"How long after an executed refund until it appears on the card or original payment method? Expected posting timeline."}
